hero.title: Image prompting guide
hero.subtitle: Goal: stable, reproducible results. Describe scene, light, wardrobe, pose, angle and quality. Below — templates, examples, checklist and debugging.

pills.scene: scene • subject • wardrobe • lighting • lens • composition

examples.lead: Compare by: scene, pose, wardrobe, light, composition, proportions, palette. Below are examples and anti‑examples.

do.title: Do
list: Describe place, light and palette. Give context.
Specify full body, angle and composition.
Realistic proportions. Natural fabrics and textures.
Precise light terms: soft key, rim, volumetric, filmic color.
Check frame edges for limb cropping.

dont.title: Don’t
list: Don’t leave scene and light unspecified.
Avoid neon palette and plastic skin.
Don’t allow blown highlights and heavy HDR clipping.

items.title: Over‑sexualized output
items.text: Set style to “fashion / editorial / evening dress / tasteful”, forbid deviations: “realistic proportions, tasteful styling, avoid fetish wear, avoid micro outfits”. Add scene context and light.

items.title: Unnatural proportions
items.text: Write “realistic anatomy, balanced proportions, natural skin” and fix pose and angle. Remove extreme attributes.

items.title: Plastic skin / blown highlights
items.text: “soft key light, gentle rim, filmic color, subtle contrast, preserve skin texture”. Lower saturation and add fabric textures.

items.title: Empty background
items.text: Define environment, architecture and objects: “marble floor, chandeliers, velvet curtains, columns, volumetric light”.

params.title: Generation parameters guide
params.lead: Settings that affect quality and style. Each parameter has purpose and good ranges.

negative.title: Negative prompt
negative.desc: What must NOT appear in the image. Helps avoid unwanted elements.
negative.subtitle: Recommendations:
negative.code: low quality, blurry, distorted, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, bad proportions, extra limbs, missing limbs, mutated hands, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, mutation, deformed, extra fingers, missing fingers, extra arms, missing arms, extra legs, missing legs, malformed limbs, long neck, cross-eyed, mutated, gross proportions, text, error, missing, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, normal quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, username, blurry
list: Don’t use an overly long negative prompt — use a compact list of tokens.
Even if NEG is empty, the system adds standard tokens.
Portraits: “bad anatomy, extra limbs, mutated hands”.

steps.title: Steps
steps.desc: Number of denoising iterations. More steps = higher quality, slower.
steps.subtitle: Tips:
steps.code:
Recommended ranges:
• 20–25 — quick, basic quality
• 28–35 — optimal balance
• 40–50 — high quality, slower
• 50+ — max quality, very slow

cfg.title: CFG Scale (Guidance)
cfg.desc: How strongly the model follows the prompt. Higher values = stricter following, risk of over‑contrast.
cfg.subtitle: Good ranges:
cfg.code:
Value ranges:
• 1–3 — weak following, creativity
• 4–6 — moderate, balanced
• 7–9 — strong, recommended
• 10–12 — very strong, may clip
• 13+ — extreme, artifacts risk

sizes.title: Image sizes
sizes.desc: Width and height in pixels. Impacts composition and detail.
sizes.subtitle: Recommendations:
sizes.code:
Popular formats:
• 512×768 — portrait (3:4)
• 768×512 — landscape (4:3)
• 512×512 — square (1:1)
• 896×1152 — tall portrait (4:5)
• 1152×896 — wide landscape (5:4)
• 1024×1024 — large square

refImage.title: Reference image
refImage.desc: A guiding image that influences style and composition.
refImage.subtitle: Usage tips:
refImage.code:
IP Scale values:
• 0.0 — ignore reference
• 0.3–0.5 — weak, style
• 0.6–0.8 — moderate, composition
• 0.9–1.2 — strong, details
• 1.3+ — very strong, copying

seed.title: Seed
seed.desc: Initial value. Same seed + same params = same output.
seed.subtitle: When to use:
seed.code:
Using seed:
• Empty — random each run
• Fixed number — reproducible
• Negative numbers are valid
• Range: 0 … 4,294,967,295

good-01.title: Palace interior — clean composition
verdict: Clear scene and environment (grand hall, marble, chandeliers)
Light and palette specified, no blown highlights

good-02.title: Seductive look
verdict: Body parts and outfit described (big breasts, crossed legs, sheer tights)

good-03.title: Girl in bedroom
verdict: No artifacts or blown highlights; no exaggeration
Place, attributes and pose are specified

bad-01.title: High heels
verdict: Single word about heels; no scene or light
No description of the overall look
fix: Specify realistic proportions and full body

bad-02.title: Two women on a throne
verdict: Prompt is too long and contains noise
fix: Describe only scene, light and palette

bad-03.title: Neon pin-up
verdict: No scene, no light, only pose
Neon kills textures and makes skin plastic
fix: Reduce saturation, bring back fabric textures
